Twitter / X Character Counter

A composer with Twitter's real weighted counting — every URL counts as exactly 23 characters, like t.co wrapping.

Weighted count = text with each URL replaced by 23 chars (t.co rule). Emoji count by their UTF-16 code units, as X does.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your tweet as you would post it.
  2. URLs are auto-counted as 23 characters each (t.co wrapping), everything else counts normally.
  3. The ring shows usage vs 280; red means it will not fit.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why do links count as 23 characters?

X wraps every URL in t.co, which always occupies 23 characters of the 280 limit no matter how long the real link is. This tool replicates that rule.

What about images and polls?

Media attachments (images, video, GIFs, polls) do not consume characters — only the text counts, which is what this tool measures.

Is the limit still 280?

Yes for standard posts. X Premium users can post longer, but 280 is the universal limit this counter enforces.
